(async () => { const files = Capacitor.Plugins.GraceFiles; const access = await files.open(); const { entries } = await files.list(access); const file = entries.find((entry) => entry.name === "Exercise.pdf"); const target = { ...access, id: file.id }; const shown = await files.preview({ ...target, page: 1 }); await files.remove(target); await files.close(access); return { kind: file.kind, pages: file.pages, image: shown.image.startsWith("data:image/jpeg;base64,") }; })()
